notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42264064/2bcbb79f1a4550bc813631b3b8a55559c380c64b.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello people! [/b][/h1]

If you enjoyed Loathful, I’m thrilled to share that my next horror game, FESTERED, is in the works! 🎮 This time, you’ll venture into a decaying research facility overrun by fungal infestations and terrifying creatures.

A demo is coming soon, so stay tuned to get an early taste of the chilling experience and let’s dive into the horror together again!
